issues.legal_issue: The priority conferred on secured creditors by Section 26E of the SARFAESI Act prevails over recovery under the MSMED Act from secured assets.
Sections 15 to 23 read with Section 24 of the MSMED Act do not confer priority on MSMED Act awards over secured creditors or create a conflict with the SARFAESI Act on payment priority.

A magistrate acting under Section 14 of the SARFAESI Act has no jurisdiction to adjudicate disputes between a secured creditor and a debtor or to refuse possession based on pending recovery certificates under the MSMED Act.
A person aggrieved by measures under Section 13(4) or an order under Section 14 of the SARFAESI Act must seek relief before the Debts Recovery Tribunal under Section 17.
